headline: Teladoc Health Appoints Financial Executive Mark Anquillare to Its Board of Directors
summary: NEW YORK, Aug. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Teladoc Health (NYSE: TDOC), the global leader in virtual care, today announced the appointment of Mark V. Anquillare to its board of directors. Mr. Anquillare is the former president and chief operating officer of Verisk Analytics, a strategic data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry.
